content:
sarah_cs: Hey team — Acme's hitting intermittent 500s and says they can't find a request ID in their logs. Can I get a short, copy-paste list of steps for the customer (web, mobile, server/curl) and a checklist for what to include in a debug bundle? Keep it customer-friendly and call out redaction of secrets.

mike_oncall: Short list is best. Ask them to send: 1) the top-level request id (from response header or SDK log) 2) a HAR or curl of the failing request 3) timestamp + route (approx) 4) SDK debug token or device logs if mobile 5) a screenshot of Console -> Requests if they use the UI. Call out "do not share API keys". Example minimal curl (ask them to replace token with <REDACTED>):

```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"test"}'
```

Tell them to paste the full response headers (the server returns a request id header like `x-request-id` or `request-id`) — we need that header value.

jess_engineer: Console steps to include (one-liners):
- Web UI: Console -> Requests (filter by time) -> click failing row -> copy Request ID and attach screenshot. The Request ID generally starts with `rwd_` or looks like a short UUID.
- Browser repro: open DevTools -> Network -> reproduce -> right-click failing entry -> Save -> Export HAR. Send only the failing request's HAR or highlight it.
- Server/curl: run the curl above, and attach the full response (headers + body). The response will include `x-request-id` in headers; paste that value.
- Mobile SDKs: tell them to enable debug logging for a short run (do not leave debug on in prod). Example phrasing for them: "Turn on SDK debug, reproduce the error, then attach the SDK log lines containing `request_id` or `x-request-id`."
  - iOS: ask for device console logs (Console.app / Xcode) and grep for "request_id"; attach a 30s window around the error.
  - Android: ask for `adb logcat | grep request_id` output for the timeframe.

mike_oncall: If they can't produce a HAR, a curl that reproduces the failure is fine. Also ask them to include: timestamp (UTC), route (e.g., /v1/generate), model (if provided), and the client region/region header if applicable.

jess_engineer: Debug bundle checklist to give the customer (what to attach to the ticket):
- the request id (exact header value)
- HAR or curl + response headers
- SDK debug log or device logs (mobile)
- exact local time (UTC) when it happened and timezone offset
- a minimal repro payload (trimmed to the smallest input that still fails)
- screenshots of Console -> Requests if they see the error in the UI
- confirm any proxies/CDNs between them and our API (we need to know if header rewrite might occur)

redwood-bot: [ticket #INC-2026] created and linked to this thread.

sarah_cs: Perfect — I'll send this to Acme. One last line to include in customer message: "Please redact your API key from any attachments and replace it with <REDACTED_TOKEN>. If you need help collecting logs we can do a short Zoom."

mike_oncall: Also add: if they provide an SDK debug token (we sometimes ask for `debug_token=...`), include the token string and the request-id so we can pull a server-side bundle. If they can't find a token, send the things above and we'll escalate.

sarah_cs: Thanks — sending now. Will update the ticket when they reply. :thumbsup:
